answer.text:
From Adobe Inc.'s **Consolidated Statements of Income** for the fiscal year ended November 29, 2024:

- **Total revenue:** $21,505 million
- **Gross profit:** $19,147 million  
*(Accession: `0000796343-25-000004`, Section: `CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME`, Chunk ID: `c8e23789-3e5b-5998-a527-7bb13e5d5a92`)*

### **Calculation**
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin Percentage} = \frac{\text{Gross Profit}}{\text{Total Revenue}} \times 100$$

$$\text{Gross Profit Margin Percentage} = \frac{\$19,147}{\$21,505} \times 100 \approx 89.0351\% \text{ (or } 89.04\% \text{ rounded to two decimal places)}$$

*(Note: In Note 2 - Revenue, this is also reported rounded to **89%** [Chunk ID: `b8fa3362-a910-51b7-aebe-a44fa81085a4`]).*
